args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

src/money.py documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Fix
- Switched `round_money()` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` when quantizing to cents.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`.
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675"))` → `2.68` and `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` → `2.66` (banker's rounding).

This is a small, targeted fix so the tests go green and the fix can ship in today's release.
